info.title: BeelPoint API
info.description: BeelPoint connects your business to the Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) for e-invoicing and tax compliance in Nigeria. Use these endpoints to retrieve reference data, validate and sign invoices, generate Invoice Reference Numbers (IRN) and confirm transmission.

get.description: Returns the list of invoice types available in the Beelpoint API.

value.description: Name or description of the invoice type

get.description: Retrieves Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) codes, each with a code and a description.

data.description: Stone articles and articles of other mineral substances; n.e.c. or included in heading no. 6815
Bricks, blocks, tiles and other ceramic goods of siliceous fossil meals (e.g. kieselguhr, tripolite or diatomite) or of similar siliceous earths

get.description: Retrieves invoices for your business with pagination details.
Retrieves the details of a single invoice by its unique ID.

post.description: Validates and signs an invoice for a business.
Validates invoice details. The documentation does not state whether a successful call stores the invoice.
Generates an Invoice Reference Number (IRN) for an invoice to be signed.

invoiceId.description: ID of the invoice to be signed

post.description: Confirms the transmission of an invoice identified by its Invoice Reference Number (IRN).

parameters.name: irn
parameters.description: Invoice Reference Number (IRN) of the invoice to confirm

irn.description: Invoice Reference Number (IRN) of the invoice to be confirmed

post.description: Validates multiple invoices in one request. The response reports how many invoices were processed, how many passed, and which ones failed with field-level errors. A batch can partly succeed.

invoices.description: Array of invoice objects to process

400.description: Bad Request. The request body must contain an array of invoices.

example.message: Request body must contain an array of invoices.

get.description: Returns the list of available tax categories for invoices.

id.description: Tax category code, for example ZERO_GST. See Retrieve Tax Categories.

line_extension_amount.description: Sum of line amounts before tax

hsn_code.description: Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) code. See Retrieve HSN codes.

base_quantity.description: Base quantity the price applies to

issue_time.description: Time the invoice was issued, format HH:MM:SS

invoice_type_code.description: Invoice type code. See Retrieve Invoice Types.

document_currency_code.description: Currency of the invoice, for example NGN

charge_indicator.description: True for a charge, false for an allowance

paymentDetails.description: Payment details (appears in documented examples; structure not documented)

invoiceNumber.description: Your invoice number (appears in documented examples)

invoiceCategory.description: Invoice category, for example B2B, B2C or B2G. See Invoice Categories Options.
